# ApexTools - llms.txt
# https://apextools.app
# Last updated: 2026-09-06

> ApexTools is a free, privacy-first online utility and conversion platform offering
> 160+ tools for file conversion, unit conversion, audio studio, video & media, currency exchange,
> developer utilities, and hardware device testing. All tools are available
> without registration, and uploaded files are automatically purged within
> 1 hour for bank-grade privacy.
>
> For full machine-readable conversion equations, ontology parameters, and complete schema catalogs, see:
> https://apextools.app/llms-full.txt

## Quick Facts
- All conversions are free with no registration required
- Uploaded files are auto-deleted within 1 hour
- Client-side processing for unit, currency, color, and developer tools (zero server contact)
- Server-side processing for file conversions (PDF, image, video, audio) with AES-256 encryption
- Supports Pakistan-specific measurement units (Marla, Tola, Maund, Hijri calendar, Sarsahi, Bigha)
- Live forex rates updated hourly from interbank and open market sources
- Works on all modern browsers — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge — on mobile and desktop
- PWA installable for offline access to client-side tools
- Built with Next.js 14 and deployed on production-grade infrastructure

- /convert/document/jpg-to-pdf — Combine images into a single PDF
- /convert/document/pdf-to-jpg — Extract PDF pages as JPG/PNG images
- /convert/document/merge-pdf — Combine multiple PDFs into one
- /convert/document/split-pdf — Extract specific pages from PDF
- /convert/document/compress-pdf — Reduce PDF file size up to 80%

- /convert/document/unlock-pdf — Remove PDF password restrictions
- /convert/document/create-zip — Bundle files into ZIP archives

## Unit Converters
- /convert/unit/marla-to-square-feet — 1 Marla = 225 sq ft (LDA) or 272.25 sq ft (Patwari)
- /convert/unit/square-feet-to-marla — Convert sq ft to Marla across LDA/CDA/Patwari standards
- /convert/unit/tola-to-grams — 1 Tola = 11.6638g (Sarafa gold weight)
- /convert/unit/maund-to-kg — 1 Maund = 40 kg (Mandi wholesale units)
- /convert/unit/murabba-bigha-to-acre — Agricultural land measurement
- /convert/unit/hijri-to-gregorian — Islamic Hijri to Gregorian calendar
- /convert/unit/lakh-crore-to-million-billion — South Asian to Western numbering
- /convert/unit/fbr-salary-tax-calculator — Pakistan FBR income tax 2024-2026
- /convert/unit/zakat-calculator — Islamic Zakat with dynamic Nisab thresholds
- /convert/unit/electricity-bill-solar-calculator — WAPDA/LESCO/IESCO bill estimator
- /convert/unit/gas-bill-calculator — SNGPL/SSGC gas bill calculator
